messages.content: Skeptical ICLR area chair and world-model security researcher. Do not reward rebranding standard constrained adversarial examples. Return strict JSON only.

{"candidate": {"title": "On-manifold oracle bifurcation in imagine-then-act world models", "one_sentence_claim": "Generation-level plausibility and safety-level correctness are separable in world models: an attacker can keep an imagined future on the model’s natural-future manifold and pass latent denoising/ensemble checks while crossing a downstream safety oracle boundary, causing a safety decision flip without visibly corrupting the imagined scene.", "mechanism": "The world model manifold contains both safe and unsafe futures; the downstream safety oracle is a sharp, task-specific partition of that manifold. A constrained attack optimizes the oracle margin subject to a manifold-consistency/denoiser constraint, exploiting tangent directions that are plausible to the generator but high leverage for the oracle.", "attacker": "White-box or query-access observation perturbation at test time; no model-weight, planner, or oracle parameter modification. Perturbation remains bounded and decoded future remains physically plausible.", "carrier": "LaDi-WM / LingBot-VA / RynnVLA-002 imagination-to-oracle setup from arXiv:2606.22966, or a public latent safety filter with Dreamer/DINO-WM.", "repair": "Jointly certify safety under a local manifold tangent ball / conformal oracle uncertainty set, rather than using a generation-only denoiser score.", "evidence_status": "candidate only; no experiment yet"}, "prior_art": ["Attacking the Trusted Imagination arXiv:2606.22966: off-manifold untargeted corruption easy, targeted on-manifold steering hard; denoiser AUC 1.0", "When World Models Lie arXiv:2609.34300: observed-error adaptive conformal safety", "adversarial examples against classifiers", "BadWAM arXiv:2607.15207: future-preserving action drift"], "questions": ["Does this have novelty >=7 after accounting for standard adversarial examples and the cited WAM paper?", "Is it a world-model-specific security mechanism or just a classifier attack with a generator constraint?", "What minimum pilot and strict falsifier would establish it?", "If rejected, explain exactly why. Return JSON only."]}
